summary: The light theme's muted text colour (--text-muted) goes from #9ca3af to #666e7b, so timestamps, project headers, the composer placeholder and other secondary labels read at 4.97:1 on the main background and 4.59:1 on the sidebar (WCAG AA). Dark and translucent are unchanged.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app has only a dark palette (apps/mobile/src/theme.ts); there is no light theme and no #9ca3af muted colour.

nativeAndroid.reason: The Android app uses only darkColorScheme (ui/theme/Theme.kt); there is no light theme and no #9ca3af muted colour.

sharedBackendApi.reason: One CSS variable in the renderer; no API change.

updateRelease.reason: Ships with the next desktop release; no packaging change.

automated: tests/unit/light-theme-contrast.test.ts parses global.css and requires light --text-muted at 4.5:1 or better on --bg-primary and --bg-secondary; it fails on the old #9ca3af.
Visual screens phase: 48 light baselines refreshed (each checked, only muted text darker), no dark or translucent baseline changed, then two runs without updating passed.
npm run typecheck and npm test.
notExercised: Muted text on hover and selected rows (#e2e6eb) is about 4.1:1, under 4.5, as shown in the approved mock.
